version: LOCK 99 V1 (9 Nov 2026) - the prayer in 3D

prayer3d.title: In the rows
prayer3d.text: In the 3D game the camera rises behind the rows when the prayer starts. The imam stands alone in front; the rows fill from the middle outwards, shoulder to shoulder; you take the next free place. Each position plays for its time; any key skips to the end.
positions: at the end of the last rak'ah
